findings.title: No valid JSON-LD structured data (Organization expected)
findings.evidence: Raw HTML of https://news.ycombinator.com/ contains 0 JSON-LD script block(s), none of which parsed as a valid schema.org object.

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD to this homepage/landing page — currently 0 valid structured data blocks are present; crawlers have no machine-readable identity or facts to extract.

findings.title: Missing/empty head tags: meta[description], og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:title, twitter:description
findings.evidence: Page https://news.ycombinator.com/ is missing these <head> fields (absent or empty): meta[description], og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:title, twitter:description.

suggested_action.summary: Add a meta description and OG/Twitter tags summarising 'Hacker News' — currently meta[description], og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:title, twitter:description are empty, giving AI assistants no summary text to preview or cite.

findings.title: No 'last updated' or publication date signal on content page
findings.evidence: Page https://news.ycombinator.com/news has no article:published_time, no article:modified_time meta tag, and no visible 'last updated / as of [date]' text in the body.

suggested_action.summary: Add a visible 'last updated' or version note (e.g. 'Updated September 2026') so AI assistants have a freshness signal to cite confidently — undated content is treated as potentially stale.

findings.title: No company-level orientation text on homepage
findings.evidence: The homepage https://news.ycombinator.com/ contains no sentence that states what 'Hacker News' is as a company/platform. The page describes individual products or features but never introduces the parent entity.

suggested_action.summary: Add a short 'what is Hacker News' section (2–3 plain-text sentences) to the homepage — AI assistants use this to understand and cite the entity accurately.

findings.title: High boilerplate-to-content ratio: only 99% is primary content
findings.evidence: Page https://news.ycombinator.com/news: ~738 primary-content words out of 739 total words (99% unique content). No semantic <article>/<main> boundary found — extraction tools cannot reliably isolate primary content.

suggested_action.summary: Wrap the primary content in a clear semantic boundary (<article> or <main>) so extraction tools can reliably isolate it from surrounding site chrome (related links, sidebars, nav, footer) — currently only ~99% of page text is primary content.

findings.title: Wikipedia/Wikidata linked in DOM but not in Organization schema sameAs
findings.evidence: Page https://news.ycombinator.com/ links to Wikipedia/Wikidata from the DOM but does not include this URL in the Organization JSON-LD sameAs field.

suggested_action.summary: Add the Wikipedia/Wikidata URL to the Organization JSON-LD sameAs array for 'Hacker News' — it's already linked from the DOM; formalising it in structured data makes the entity-identity connection machine-readable.

findings.title: No trust content (testimonials, reviews, case studies) on key page
findings.evidence: Page https://news.ycombinator.com/ has no testimonials, reviews, client quotes, or case-study snippets — only logos/brand names at most.

suggested_action.summary: Add 2–3 named, attributed client quotes or case-study snippets — currently only brand/client logos appear with no accompanying text, giving visitors no social proof they can read or that a crawler can cite.

flag_only_items.reason: Facts on https://news.ycombinator.com/ should be spot-checked against third-party directories, retailers, or press coverage for outdated versions (old price, old logo, discontinued product, changed leadership). This requires checking sources beyond this page and cannot be confirmed from a single-page fetch.
flag_only_items.recommendation: Manually spot-check key facts (pricing, team, product specs, statistics) against third-party sources (Google My Business, LinkedIn, press coverage, industry directories) to identify and correct any outdated information circulating externally.

flag_only_items.reason: Deep-link matching cannot be verified from a single-page fetch of https://news.ycombinator.com/. AI assistants referring visitors to a brand may link to the homepage rather than the specific product/service page matching the user's query.
flag_only_items.recommendation: Ensure AI-assistant-referred and search-referred visitors land on the specific product/service page matching their query, not the homepage — verify that deep links exist for each key product/service, with unique URLs and descriptive titles. Test by asking an AI assistant about your key products and checking where it links.
